title: Audit Checkbox filter visual depth
description: Audit Checkbox for option layout, custom check icons, label/count alignment, selected/hover/focus states, wrapping, and field binding.
objective: Identify the full customization and behavior contract for Checkbox instead of treating it as a default browser control.
acceptance_criteria: The audit covers list, inline, grid, and wrapped layouts.
The audit checks whether checkbox style controls are independent from radio/chips where needed.
The audit identifies missing selected, hover, focus, disabled, and count styles.
The audit ties checkbox values to field binding and option parsing.
verification: Source-backed findings cite render, CSS, JS, and control IDs.
No Checkbox implementation is made by this task.

budgets.context_budget: checkbox audit, render, CSS, option parsing

risks: Checkbox can look like native form residue unless custom anatomy and states are deliberate.
